LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_QuestDescription:
An automated delivery node offers your colony 1 free Master qualification module.

Accept for delivery by drop pod to your base. Delivery waits if no base is available. No combat, payment or acceptance deadline.

The module permanently unlocks Master selection. See the item description for use conditions.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_DebugRequestTip: Create a quest for 1 free module, regardless of research or previous grants. Another unfinished claim quest blocks duplicates.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_AlreadyPending: A claim quest is unfinished. Resolve it first.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_NoMap: Requires a player base that can receive drop pods.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_CreateFailed: Quest creation failed. Will retry automatically.
LanguageData.SSC_MasterEntry_Created: Claim quest created. Accept it in the quest list.
